requirements.description: Visual system & micro-interactions: calm, high-craft Chinese UI across home + workbench + share pages; light/dark follows `prefers-color-scheme`; restrained refined micro-interactions (smooth tab indicator/panel transitions, subtle running pulse, timeline card expand polish) strictly respecting `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Ensure zero clipped text in 我的项目 cards at 1280px & 375px, and ensure the code pane keeps long source lines readable at 1280px & 375px via clean horizontal scroll or wrap toggle.

Empty / loading / error / UX completeness states: Discoverable Chinese follow-up prompt input + send control in the workbench left rail (starts an incremental iteration run directly from UI, disabled while a run is active or on read-only share view). Accurate persisted `runs.qa_rounds` reflected on workbench metadata including when hitting the 3-round exhaustion cap (`已达修复上限`). Clear Chinese empty / loading / error / interrupted (`继续`) / rate-limit / Gemini→replay fallback banner (`演示回放`) / preview compile error states, plus disabled pending feedback on ZIP export and share creation.

Accessibility: keyboard focus-visible rings on primary controls, meaningful landmarks/headings, labelled tabs and iframe preview, contrast meets WCAG AA for text on backgrounds used (both light and dark modes).

Performance: fast home + workbench shell load, long-term `Cache-Control` headers for static preview runtime assets (`/preview/*`), idle preloading of `esbuild.wasm` (`requestIdleCallback` / low-priority fetch) when feasible, zero CLS from external font CDNs (system font stack only).
Desktop / Mobile preview width toggle (`桌面` / `移动 375px`) on the 预览 tab, keeping the preview sandboxed (`allow-scripts` only) and responsive.

Delivery documentation (paraphrase only — never paste confidential hiring-brief text or secret keys): Polished `README.md`: project positioning ("可验证的 AI 应用生成"), architecture overview, local dev/test quickstart, and links to delivery docs. Detailed `docs/DELIVERY.md` (and `docs/writeup.md` symlink or matching write-up): (a) architecture & key trade-offs (Plan A `esbuild-wasm` vs WebContainer, China reachability, harness-in-product story), (b) completion status (what is done vs known limitations), (c) prioritized next-step roadmap, (d) step-by-step Cloudflare deployment commands (`npx wrangler login`, D1 database creation & schema migration, `npx wrangler secret put GEMINI_API_KEY`, `pnpm run build:cf` / deploy to `atoms.maoxunxing.com`).

Mainland-China reachability & security audit: scripted verification asserting zero runtime requests to external CDNs (`esm.sh`, `unpkg`, `jsdelivr`, `cdn.tailwindcss.com`, `fonts.googleapis.com`, `fonts.gstatic.com`) across home, workbench, and share routes, and custom domain path (`atoms.maoxunxing.com`) documented with `aws:us-east-1` placement.

Calm high-craft Chinese UI across home, workbench, and share matches REF-1 density, tab chrome, and card language without marketing flash.
Screenshots at 1280×800 and 375×812 show zero clipped 我的项目 card text and reachable long code lines.
Pitfall absent: tab/timeline/running-pulse animations continue when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is set.

Follow-up control is discoverable in the left rail with clear disabled/pending feedback, and Chinese state banners are unambiguous.

items.command: LLM_PROVIDER=mock pnpm exec playwright test e2e/polish.spec.ts --grep "a11y|focus-visible|landmarks"
items.description: Keyboard tab order reaches prompt submit, follow-up, timeline expanders, preview width toggle, and preview/code/version tabs; tabs and iframe are labelled.
Primary controls show focus-visible rings; landmarks/headings and contrast remain WCAG AA-ready in light and dark.
Pitfall absent: primary interactive controls lack a visible focus ring or the preview iframe/tabs are unlabelled.
Preview runtime stays self-hosted; Cache-Control configuration for /preview/* and idle preload hooks for esbuild.wasm are present and covered by unit checks where applicable.
No Google Fonts or other external font CDN URLs are referenced from application source.
Home and workbench shells feel fast with system fonts only and no font-CDN-induced CLS.
Pitfall absent: app routes pull Tailwind CDN or Google Fonts at runtime.

Pitfall absent: preview sandbox gains allow-same-origin or drops allow-scripts.
